Replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, addressed to you:

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. Your message said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel records nothing else about the guard between that and the 11:03 AM update, when Mateo reported kiosk 1 back and the guard checking in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 AM note says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
